title: 👉 You: answer 6 more design questions for the kaiju game
summary: > ## 👉 What I need from you (~5 min) > **Answer 6 design questions (round 2) for the kaiju game.** > > **How:** > 1. Read each question. Each has my recommended answer (➡️). > 2. Comment on this issue. > > **Reply with a comment:** `yes all`, or `yes all except 2: `. Round 1 answers are recorded in [docs/chief/vision.md](https://github.com/thomas-tahk/rogue-kaiju/blob/placeholder-art/docs/chief/vision.md). **Q1 — What annoyed you.** In Rampage, Slay the Spire or similar games: what got boring, frustrating or tedious? (e.g. "Rampage got samey after 3 cities", "StS runs too long".) This gets written down as things we must avoid. ➡️ No guess — your answer needed (or `skip`). **Q2 — View: try before deciding.** First build = a throwaway "feel test": the same one-city smash in 3 rough versions with grey boxes: (a) flat 2D side view, (b) 2.5D (side view with a few depth lanes you walk between), (c) low-poly 3D. You play all three on your PC and pick. The real game starts after that. ➡️ Yes, all three. **Q3 — Route map.** Each act = a branching map, StS-style. Node types: **City** (smash it, main node), **Rival kaiju** (harder fight, better reward), **Event** (short text choice), **Lab** (heal or swap a mutation). Each act ends with a boss. ➡️ Yes. Counts and lengths tuned by play-testing. **Q4 — Kaiju-vs-kaiju fights use the same controls.** A rival kaiju fight happens inside a city with the same moves you use for smashing (not a separate fighting-game mode), so one combat system serves both. ➡️ Yes. **Q5 — Tone: a mix across nodes.** Cities are comedic Rampage chaos (tiny soldiers, screaming people); rival kaiju fights and bosses are more dramatic monster-movie moments. ➡️ Yes. **Q6 — Mobile.** PC first, no design limits for mobile now (no touch-friendly controls required). Ports decided after it's fun. ➡️ Yes.
